# qdrant-cloud_serverless_space (Resource)

Serverless Space Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Setup Terraform, including the qdrant-cloud providers
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.7.0"
  required_providers {
    qdrant-cloud = {
      source  = "qdrant/qdrant-cloud"
      version = ">=1.1.0"
    }
  }
}

// Add the provider to specify some provider wide settings
provider "qdrant-cloud" {
  api_key    = "" // API Key generated in Qdrant Cloud (required)
  account_id = "" // The default account ID you want to use in Qdrant Cloud (can be overriden on resource level)
}

// Pick the first available serverless cloud region
data "qdrant-cloud_serverless_cloud_regions" "all" {}
locals {
  cloud_region_id = [for r in data.qdrant-cloud_serverless_cloud_regions.all.regions : r.id if r.available][0]
}

// Create a serverless space
resource "qdrant-cloud_serverless_space" "example" {
  name            = "example-space"
  cloud_region_id = local.cloud_region_id

  labels {
    key   = "team"
    value = "search"
  }

  configuration {
    allowed_ip_source_ranges = ["10.0.0.0/8"]
    searcher_settings {
      idle_timeout = "15m"
    }
  }

  delete_backups = true // Delete the backups of the space when it is destroyed
}

// Output the endpoint of the space
output "space_url" {
  value = qdrant-cloud_serverless_space.example.url
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Serverless Space Schema Name of the space (4-64 characters: letters, numbers, `-` and `_`). Unique within the account field

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) Serverless Space Schema Account ID (defaults to the provider account ID) field
- `cloud_region_id` (String) Serverless Space Schema Cloud region where the space is hosted (see the `qdrant-cloud_serverless_cloud_regions` data source). Required unless `from_backup_id` is set, in which case the region of the backup is used field
- `configuration` (Block List, Max: 1) Serverless Space Schema Configuration of the space field (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--configuration))
- `cost_allocation_label` (String) Serverless Space Schema Key of the label sent as metadata when metering usage through cloud marketplaces, for cost allocation field
- `delete_backups` (Boolean) Whether the backups of the space should be deleted when the space is destroyed. Defaults to false.
- `from_backup_id` (String) ID of a serverless backup to create the space from. Changing this forces a new space to be created.
- `labels` (Block Set, Max: 10) Serverless Space Schema Labels of the space, used in the cloud UI and billing reports (max 10) field (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--labels))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Serverless Space Schema Creation time field
- `grpc_port` (Number) Serverless Space Schema Port for gRPC calls field
- `id` (String) Serverless Space Schema Space ID field
- `rest_port` (Number) Serverless Space Schema Port for HTTP REST calls field
- `state` (List of Object) Serverless Space Schema Current state of the space field (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--state))
- `url` (String) Serverless Space Schema URL (without port) to access the space field

<a id="nestedblock--configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration`

Optional:

- `allowed_ip_source_ranges` (List of String) List of allowed IPv4 source ranges (CIDR) for this space (max 40).
- `allowed_origins` (List of String) List of origins (scheme + host + optional port, e.g. `https://app.example.com`) from which browser-based clients are allowed to call the space via CORS (max 10).
- `collection_settings` (Block List, Max: 1) Per-collection size limits for this space. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--configuration--collection_settings))
- `searcher_settings` (Block List, Max: 1) Search-worker settings for this space. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--configuration--searcher_settings))

Read-Only:

- `last_modified_at` (String) Time when the configuration was last updated.
- `max_collections_per_space` (Number) Platform-enforced limit on the number of collections for this space (0 means unlimited).

<a id="nestedblock--configuration--collection_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration.collection_settings`

Optional:

- `max_size` (Number) Customer-defined maximum size in bytes per collection, used for cost control. Must not exceed `platform_max_size`.

Read-Only:

- `platform_max_size` (Number) Platform-enforced maximum size in bytes per collection (0 means unlimited).


<a id="nestedblock--configuration--searcher_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration.searcher_settings`

Optional:

- `idle_timeout` (String) Idle timeout after which idle search workers may be scaled down, as a Go duration string (between "1m" and "15m", defaults to "5m").
- `max_workers` (Number) Maximum number of search workers per collection in this space (defaults to 2).

Read-Only:

- `platform_max_workers` (Number) Platform-enforced maximum number of search workers per collection (0 means unlimited).

## Import

`qdrant-cloud_serverless_space` can be imported using the space ID, e.g.

```
$ terraform import qdrant-cloud_serverless_space.example 12345678-0000-0000-0000-1234567890ab
```

Note that `from_backup_id` and `delete_backups` are not returned by the API, so they are not set after import.
